privileged_info_for_vlm: The target employees to be updated are EMP008, EMP010, EMP012, EMP015, EMP018, and EMP020. The new Job Title must be exactly 'Divestiture Transition Staff'. The new Employment Status must be exactly 'Divested Entity'. The email domain for all six employees must be changed to '@qaserve.com' while keeping their original 'first.last' prefix (e.g., john.doe@qaserve.com).
